title: Complex equations in Vinod's automatic writing notebook

tellings.quote: There was a lot of like very complex equations that would come through

plain: In the 1950s, at a research group in Maine called the Round Table Foundation, a man known as Dr. Vinod is said to have filled a notebook through automatic writing, meaning writing that comes out without the writer's conscious control, and very complex equations came through in it. The researcher Greg Malatzi describes this, pointing to the document known as the Nine notebook. If true, the messages would have carried knowledge their writer did not seem to have himself.
